name: cocosair
description: Route Cocos AIR tasks across subsystem skills and direct dependencies. Use to choose a primary owner, adapt Creator knowledge, or apply Code First and capability-evidence rules.

name: cocosair-2d-subsystems
description: Build DragonBones, TiledMap, particles and billboards from runtime data. Use for raw asset strings, missing pixels, MotionStreak or Spine backend limits.

name: cocosair-agent-session
description: Inspect live scenes and frames with devtools; read runtime diagnostics. Use for scoped session writes, pixel probes or duplicate requestId INVALID_ARGUMENT errors.

name: cocosair-animation-tween
description: Animate tweens and AnimationClip tracks with one step clock. Use to loop a sequence on a target, reverseTime, clean up playback or diagnose unavailable pose graphs.

name: cocosair-application
description: Configure createAirApp options, canvas, lifecycle, screen sizing and context health. Use for WEBGL2_REQUIRED startup errors, scene replacement, session cleanup or lost contexts.

name: cocosair-assets
description: Load asset URL textures, atlases and BMFont with AssetBank. Use for refcounted disposal, extension selection, cache reuse or AIR_E_ATLAS_IN_USE/AIR_E_FNT_IN_USE cleanup.

name: cocosair-audio-video
description: Play media with AudioService, VideoPlayer and WebView. Use for silent autoplay, advancing currentTime, BGM/SFX channels or DOM video and iframe overlays.

name: cocosair-camera
description: Configure Camera projection, viewports, framing and screen/world conversion. Use for split-screen, pointer rays, wrong screenToWorld results or AIR_E_ORTHO_WIDTH.

name: cocosair-gltf
description: Load glTF/GLB models, extensions, decoder injection and instances. Use for Draco/meshopt/KTX2 deployment, GLTF_DECODER_MISSING, uncoded load errors or animation loops.

name: cocosair-graphics-and-dom
description: Draw Graphics/SVG shapes and sprite masks; align a DOM overlay with UI/canvas nodes. Use for overlay placement, input interception, experimental HTML textures or AirUIMesh.

name: cocosair-input-action
description: Wire keyboard, mouse, touch and action state; navigate SceneStack pages. Use for focus, held-key resets, session gates, DOM canvas errors or persistent push/pop.

name: cocosair-materials-effects
description: Configure materials, effects, uniforms, defines and GLSL. Use for setProperty, missing textures, AIR_E_MATERIAL_NOT_READY, AIR_E_MATERIAL_TYPE or uniform buffer too small.

name: cocosair-math
description: Compute vectors, matrices, quaternions, colors and easing. Use for out-first math, frozen Vec3.UP errors, transform composition, rotation units or Mat4.invert.

name: cocosair-performance
description: Optimize draw calls with static merge, instancing and dynamic atlases. Use for frame budgets, on-demand rendering, AIR_E_MESH_CAPACITY or AIR_E_PIXEL_RATIO_IMPORT_ORDER.

name: cocosair-physics
description: Choose builtin, cannon or Box2D physics; wire rigid bodies, colliders and raycasts. Use for missing gravity, trigger filters, backend limits or material error 9642.

name: cocosair-primitives-mesh
description: Build primitive geometry, Mesh buffers and MeshRenderer bindings. Use for vertex attributes, indices, wireframes or AIR_E_PRIMITIVE_DESCRIPTOR validation.

name: cocosair-project-setup
description: Set up npm imports, package entries, importmap, TypeScript and variant builds. Use for cocosair.js installation, unresolved-import errors, page shells or build artifacts.

name: cocosair-rendering
description: Configure lighting, shadows, render targets, MSAA and sRGB. Use for offscreen pixels, post-processing, AIR_E_RENDER_TARGET_SAMPLES or AIR_E_TEXTURE_COLOR.

name: cocosair-scene-graph
description: Build Scene/Node hierarchies, Component lifecycles, layers and events. Use for reparenting, active inheritance, NodePool reuse, scene globals or resource release.

name: cocosair-skinning-morph
description: Bind skeletons, restore bind poses and drive morph weights. Use for realtime/baked deformation, AIR_E_SKINNING_JOINT_PATH or AIR_E_SKINNING_CAPACITY.

name: cocosair-ui-2d
description: Build Canvas UI with sprites, Label text, layout and widgets. Use for missing UI, viewport alignment, 2D draw order, BMFont binding or AIR_E_LABEL_WRAP.

name: cocosair-verification
description: Choose verification gates and assess browser/package evidence, write behavior and fingerprints. Use to validate changes, distinguish FAIL/UNSUPPORTED or check release readiness.

answer_checks.evidence:
`DirectionalLight.illuminance` 是照度，单位 Lux（lx）；HDR 默认值为 65000。不要把方向光的数值当作局部灯的流明或亮度。
- Point/Sphere/Spot 使用 `luminousFlux`（光通量，lm）或 `luminance`（亮度）。换算因子为 `nt2lm(size) = 4 × π² × size²`。HDR 的 `luminousFlux` setter 先除以这个因子；Point 固定使用 size=1，Sphere/Spot 使用自身 size（默认 0.15）。

检查当前是否 HDR，以及相机曝光。HDR 写入 UBO 时：方向光 illuminance 与环境光 skyIllum 都乘 camera.exposure；Point/Sphere/Spot 的 luminance 还要再乘 `standardLightMeterScale = 10000`。这个 10000 系数适用于三种局部灯，不仅 Spot。
- LDR 使用独立的 LDR 槽，写入时不再乘上述曝光：方向光用 illuminanceLDR、环境光用 skyIllumLDR，局部灯用 luminanceLDR；局部灯的 LDR luminousFlux setter 直接保存 LDR 标量。
legacy forward 只有一个普通方向主光：`scene.renderScene.mainLight`。最后激活的方向光成为主光，额外方向光不会叠加照明，也不会独立投射主方向阴影。可用 `inspectAirDirectionalLights(scene)` 查看 `mainLight` 和 `lights[].effective`。

- 主 DirectionalLight：支持 ShadowMap 的 fixed-area/CSM 路径；Planar 则沿主光方向投影到单一平面。
- SpotLight：ShadowMap 路径要求 shadowEnabled；不是 Planar 的投影光源。该路径存在，但所读记录没有单独完成本轮运行时像素采样。
- PointLight：不支持阴影生成；不能用 Spot 的结果声称 Point 已受支持。
- SphereLight：默认管线没有球灯阴影路径。
- RangedDirectionalLight：不属于此主方向光/CSM 阴影契约；Ambient 不投影。
- Planar 原生路径存在，但记录中的接收区域 ROI 像素变化尚未得到可判定验证。要记录投影范围、接收平面和 bias 并实际观察像素，不能把字段设置成功当作阴影已验证。

scene.globals.shadows.enabled = true; // 默认 false
scene.globals.shadows.type = 1;       // ShadowMap；场景配置默认 Planar（0）
light.shadowEnabled = true;          // 应是有效主方向光，默认 false
renderer.shadowCastingMode = MeshRenderer.ShadowCastingMode.ON; // 投射物默认 OFF
additional_answer_quotes: 投射模型有有效 world bounds；缺少包围盒或 castShadow 为 false 会被剔除。

answer_checks.evidence:
最后在当前构建的浏览器帧上验证阴影和亮度变化。导出、声明、字段写入成功不等于渲染验证；既有主光 ShadowMap 像素证据只覆盖记录版本中的 campfire-night 固定场景。
